actions.classify_content.description: Assign categories to text or images using the Classifier API (zero-shot/few-shot).
actions.classify_content.props.input.des: Text or image URL to classify. URLs will be treated as images, other strings as text.
actions.classify_content.props.labels.de: The labels to classify the content into.
actions.classify_content.props.model.des: The model to use for classification.
actions.classify_content.props.model.opt: jina-clip-v1 - Multimodal embedding models for images and English text
jina-clip-v2 - Multilingual multimodal embeddings for texts and images
jina-embeddings-v3 - Frontier multilingual embedding model with SOTA performance
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.deepsearch_query.description: Answer complex questions through iterative search, reading, and reasoning with the DeepSearch API.
actions.deepsearch_query.props.bad_hostn: A list of domains to be strictly excluded from content retrieval. Typically used to filter out known spam, low-quality, or irrelevant websites.
actions.deepsearch_query.props.boost_hos: A list of domains that are given a higher priority for content retrieval. Useful for domain-specific, high-quality sources that provide valuable content.
actions.deepsearch_query.props.budget_to: This determines the maximum number of tokens allowed for DeepSearch process. Larger budgets can improve response quality by enabling more exhaustive search for complex queries.
actions.deepsearch_query.props.max_attem: The maximum number of retries for solving a problem in DeepSearch process. A larger value allows DeepSearch to retry solving the problem by using different reasoning approaches and strategies.
actions.deepsearch_query.props.max_retur: The maximum number of URLs to include in the final answer/chunk. URLs are sorted by relevance and other important factors.
actions.deepsearch_query.props.no_direct: Forces the model to take further thinking/search steps even when the query seems trivial. Useful if you're using DeepSearch in scenarios where you're certain the query always needs DeepSearch, rather than for trivial questions.
actions.deepsearch_query.props.only_host: A list of domains to be exclusively included in content retrieval. All other domains will be ignored. Useful for domain-specific searches.
actions.deepsearch_query.props.reasoning: Constrains effort on reasoning for reasoning models. Reducing reasoning effort can result in faster responses and fewer tokens used on reasoning in a response.
actions.deepsearch_query.props.response_: JSON schema for structured output format. Example: { "type": "json_schema", "json_schema": { "type": "object", "properties": { "numerical_answer_only": { "type": "number" } } } }
actions.extract_webpage_content.descript: Convert a URL into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown using the Reader API.
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.cs: List of CSS selectors to target specific page elements (e.g., "body, .main-content, #article").
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.do: When enabled, the requested URL won't be cached and tracked on our server.
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.eu: All infrastructure and data processing operations reside entirely within EU jurisdiction.
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.ex: CSS selectors for elements to remove from the results (e.g., "header, footer, .ads, #sidebar").
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.fo: Choose whether to resolve to the final destination URL after following all redirects. Enable to follow the full redirect chain.
Format of the extracted content - how the webpage should be returned.
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.if: Processes content from all embedded iframes in the DOM tree.
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.im: Create an "Images" section at the end, giving downstream LLMs an overview of all visuals on the page.
All - List all images at the end
Dedup - List unique images at the end
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.js: Return response in JSON format containing URL, title, content, and timestamp (if available).
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.li: Create a "Buttons & Links" section at the end to help downstream LLMs or web agents navigate the page.
All - List all links at the end
Dedup - List unique links at the end
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.re: Remove all images from the response.
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.sh: Extracts content from all Shadow DOM roots in the document.
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.ti: Maximum page load wait time in seconds (0 means use default timeout, set a value if the default browser engine is too slow on simple webpages).
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.ur: The URL of the webpage to extract content from.
actions.extract_webpage_content.props.wa: CSS selectors to wait for before returning results (e.g., "#dynamic-content, .lazy-loaded").

JSONL lines for small batches, one JSON object per item in the form {"custom_id": "id-1", "body": {"input": "your text"}}. Provide this or an Input URL, not both.
URL of a JSONL input file (GCS, S3 or HTTP). Provide this or inline lines, not both.
Embedding model id, for example jina-embeddings-v5-text-small or jina-embeddings-v5-text-nano.

The texts to embed, one per item.
Embedding model id, for example jina-embeddings-v5-text-small. List Models returns valid ids.
Task optimization, for example retrieval.query, retrieval.passage, text-matching, classification or separation.
actions.jina_ai_get_batch.description: Get the status of a batch embedding job.
Id of the batch job, returned by Create Batch Embeddings or List Batches.
actions.jina_ai_get_model.description: Get details of a Jina model.
Id of the model, returned by List Models.
actions.jina_ai_list_batches.props.limit: Maximum number of jobs to return.
actions.jina_ai_rerank_documents.descrip: Rank documents by relevance to a query.
actions.jina_ai_rerank_documents.props.d: The texts to rank, one per item.
actions.jina_ai_rerank_documents.props.m: Reranker model id, for example jina-reranker-v3. List Models returns valid ids.
actions.jina_ai_rerank_documents.props.q: The query to rank the documents against.
actions.jina_ai_rerank_documents.props.r: Include the document text in each result.
actions.jina_ai_rerank_documents.props.t: Number of best results to return. Leave empty to return all documents.
actions.train_custom_classifier.descript: Fine-tune a classifier with labeled examples for domain-specific tasks.
actions.train_custom_classifier.props.mo: The base model to use for training.
jina-clip-v1 - Multimodal embedding models for images and English text
jina-clip-v2 - Multilingual multimodal embeddings for texts and images
jina-embeddings-v3 - Frontier multilingual embedding model with SOTA performance
actions.train_custom_classifier.props.nu: Number of training iterations to perform.
actions.web_search_summarization.descrip: Perform a web search and retrieve summarized results using the Reader API.
actions.web_search_summarization.props.b: Our API caches URL contents for a certain amount of time. Set it to true to ignore the cached result and fetch the content from the URL directly.
actions.web_search_summarization.props.e: All infrastructure and data processing operations reside entirely within EU jurisdiction.
actions.web_search_summarization.props.f: This will fetch the favicon of each URL in the SERP and include them in the response as image URI, useful for UI rendering.
actions.web_search_summarization.props.i: Returns the search results only from the specified website or domain. By default it searches the entire web.
actions.web_search_summarization.props.j: The response will be in JSON format, containing the URL, title, content, and timestamp (if available). In Search mode, it returns a list of five entries, each following the described JSON structure.
actions.web_search_summarization.props.p: The result offset. It skips the given number of results. It's used for pagination.
The country to use for the search. It's a two-letter country code.
The language to use for the search. It's a two-letter language code.
From where you want the search query to originate. It is recommended to specify location at the city level in order to simulate a real user's search.
actions.web_search_summarization.props.r: Visit every URL in the search result and return the full content using Reader. Toggle on to enable more Reader-specific options.
